text.description_html:
Hamilton MS-302-BP, 10" Bronze Letter Box

This gorgeous mail slot from Hamilton Decorative Hardware is durable and the exterior letter plated is made of solid bronze. Its plain style harkens back to an older age when a blacksmith took the time to make something sturdy yet decorative. Solid Cast construction crafted with heart and soul by master craftsmen.

The Bronze Patina Living Finish is hand rubbed for a superior high quality finished product. Give your home or office a center piece with an elegant touch that you can be extremely proud of.

Features of the Hamilton MS-302-BP Bronze Decorative Mail Slot:

  • Finish: Bronze Patina
  • Length: 10" Wide
  • Height: 3"
  • Packaged with both Exterior and Interior mail doors
  • Packaged complete with mounting hardware
  • Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Exterior Plate Material: Solid Bronze
  • Interior Plate Material: Solid Brass
  • Hamilton MS-302-BP Dimensions (PDF)

Sold Individually
